title: Helper-owned Apple Music control
description: Private local request/response files, never a network endpoint. The EnhancedPresence support directory must be owner-owned mode 0700; requests/responses and music.control.lock must be regular non-symlink owner-owned files mode 0600. All timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds. The local player must be enabled. Only the named native helper executes fixed Apple Events targeted at com.apple.Music; no global media-key fallback, script text, bundle identifier, URL or executable can be supplied by a caller. NSAppleEventsUsageDescription is mandatory in the helper app's Info.plist. One request at a time across stable/Canary/PTB processes: create music.control.lock exclusively before publishing the request; its lease ID and timestamp must match the request. Claim requests within 10 seconds and recheck that age before beginning the permission preflight. Trigger any Automation prompt with a fixed harmless Music name query, then recheck the enabled setting, matching live lease, and absolute 60-second deadline before issuing the playback action. After the permission preflight, recheck the current media player using the fixed local MediaRemote read API and require Apple Music; revalidate the lease/deadline/enabled state after that read. Playback itself is always an app-addressed Apple Event, never a global media command. The native client waits at most 60 seconds for the matching response. Client completion/cancellation removes only its own lease; a validated abandoned lease may be reclaimed after 65 seconds. A missing, replaced, stale or cancelled lease forbids playback, including after a delayed permission prompt. Responses expire after 60 seconds. Invalid requests fail closed.
